reviews.review_title: Review at Chang Kang Kung - Crescent Mall
reviews.review_text:
p911turbo
Texas474 contributions
0
A non-mainstream dining option - steaming food
Aug 2018 • Family
This was my second time dining at the restaurant and I still liked it. The restaurant locates in District 7 - a more affluent and less polluted part of the city. It is on the top level of a high-end mall called Crescent Mall where people (a lot of expats there) are calmer. The sales and retail associates seem to be more efficient and know more English and more willing to help. 

The seating arrangement of the restaurant was favorable because it minimized interaction with other patrons (unlike in District 1, most of the restaurants are so crowded). The restaurant promotes healthy steaming cooking method. So basically, you order food, and then the server will come over and cook the food for you on the steamer while making porridge underneath the really hot steamer at the same time. The server will set different times / alarms for different kinds of food for you. The porridge will be served at the end of the meal. The idea behind is that all the sauces from the different food items ordered will drip down and become natural seasoning for the porridge. We really enjoyed the porridge and it was full of flavors.

They have quite a wide variety of food to choose from. We were especially happy with the fresh veggies. Seafood was fresh and most of the food came not marinated. 

Food items were on the pricey side and portions could be improved. We ordered the most expensive and yet inclusive set and then some other different seafood items to try and they were good.

Services were good and efficient and the male manager tried his best to communicate with you even though he had limited English. And he was honest as he asked us not to order too much food in the first place. He also took away the appetizers (you will be charged for that) after we told them that we did not want them without attitudes.
